user_query: Can I return an unused product after 20 days?
reference_context: Unused products may be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Used products are not eligible for a full refund.
expected_answer: Yes. An unused product returned after 20 days is within the 30 days allowed for a full refund.

user_query: How do I change my account password?
reference_context: Users can change their password from Account Settings > Security > Change Password. A verification code is sent to the registered email address.
expected_answer: Go to Account Settings, open Security, choose Change Password, and complete the email verification step.

user_query: Do you ship to Sweden and how long does it take?
reference_context: The company ships to all European Union countries. Standard EU delivery is estimated at 3–5 business days.
expected_answer: Yes. Sweden is in the EU shipping region, and standard delivery is estimated at 3–5 business days.

user_query: Is accidental water damage covered for five years?
reference_context: The standard warranty covers manufacturing defects for two years. The approved policy does not specify accidental water-damage coverage.
expected_answer: The approved policy specifies two years of warranty coverage for manufacturing defects, but it does not specify accidental water-damage coverage.
